what: Blind design review of each maker's own marketing screenshot (README or site hero), unlabelled A-H, by a separate read-only sub-agent that was told not to identify products. Scores 1-10.

on_H_trek.best: Inbox first in the sidebar ('Waiting: a plan to review' in amber), a framed plan card with an orange 'Approve and start', a composer placeholder that says what to do next; strongest identity of the set.
faults: too many accent hues: orange, amber, green, an indigo plan border, a purple branch icon, a red stop button and a pink badge; the indigo border competes with the orange button
nearly every sidebar title is heavy bold, flattening the levels
about 200 px of dead space between 'Read 1 file and ran 1 search' and the plan card
every tab uses the same icon
a red stop button shows while the agent is waiting for approval, which mixes up the state

caveats: A is a small crop and C a strip (hierarchy guessed); A is the only light theme; D, F, G overlay a phone; all are staged marketing images.
